blocks.text: Lipids non-polar molecules ka ek dheela sa tay kiya hua group hain. Yeh pani mein hal nahin hote magar organic solvents (jaise ether, alcohol waghaira) mein hal ho jate hain. Yeh bohat mukhtalif qisam ke molecules hain aur inhein acylglycerols, waxes, phospholipids, terpenes, steroids aur prostaglandins mein baanta jata hai.
Acylglycerols (fats aur oils)

Acylglycerols do subunits se bante hain: glycerol aur fatty acid. Jo acylglycerols room temperature par liquid (maaye) hon unhein oils kehte hain, aur jo solid (thos) hon unhein fats. Janwaron mein zyada tar acylglycerols fats hain. Podon mein zyada tar oils hain, maslan moongphali (peanut) ka tel, makai (corn) ka tel, arandi (castor) ka tel waghaira.
Ester woh compound hai jo alcohol aur acid ke chemical reaction se banta hai, aur is reaction mein pani ka ek molecule nikalta hai.

Chemically acylglycerols fatty acids aur alcohol (glycerol) ke esters hain. Yeh dehydration synthesis se bante hain: acid ke carboxyl (-COOH) group se OH aur alcohol ke -OH group se H nikal kar pani banate hain, jaisa neeche dikhaya gaya hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab likhti hai ke OH alcohol se aur H acid se nikalta hai. Yeh ulta hai. Ester bante waqt acid ke carboxyl (-COOH) group se OH nikalta hai aur alcohol ke -OH group se sirf H nikalta hai; dono mil kar pani (H₂O) banate hain. Alcohol ka bacha hua O acid ke C se jur kar ester bond banata hai.

Sab se zyada milne wale acylglycerols triacylglycerols (triglycerides) hain, jinhein neutral lipids bhi kehte hain. Triacylglycerol mein fatty acid ke teen molecules (ek jaise ya mukhtalif) ek hi glycerol ke backbone (bunyadi dhanche) se jure hote hain.

Glycerol: yeh 3 carbon wala alcohol hai aur is ke har carbon par ek hydroxyl (OH) group hota hai. Glycerol ke yeh 3 carbons acylglycerol molecule ka backbone banate hain, jis se teen fatty acids jurte hain.

Fatty acids: acylglycerols ki saari khususiyaat (characteristics) fatty acids ki wajah se hain. Fatty acids lambi hydrocarbon zanjeerein hain (jin mein carbon jufat (even) tadaad mein, 4 se 30 tak hote hain), jo carboxyl (-COOH) group par khatam hoti hain. In ki lambai mukhtalif hoti hai; yeh seedhi zanjeer (janwaron mein) ya shaakhdar ya ring wali (podon mein) ho sakti hain. Yeh do qisam ke hain:
Jis fatty acid mein ek double bond ho usay mono-unsaturated, aur jis mein ek se zyada double bonds hon usay poly-unsaturated kehte hain.

items: Saturated fatty acids ki hydrocarbon zanjeer mein koi double bond nahin hota. In mein andar ke har carbon atom par hydrogen lage hote hain (yani hydrogen se “bhare” hue). Yeh seedhi zanjeerein banate hain aur in ka melting point (pighalne ka darja) zyada hota hai.

Unsaturated fatty acids mein carbon atoms ke ek ya zyada joron ke darmiyan double bonds (zyada se zyada 6) hote hain. Double bonds kuch hydrogen atoms ki jagah le lete hain, is liye in mein hydrogen poore nahin hote. Yeh muri hui (bent) zanjeerein banate hain aur in ka melting point kam hota hai.

blocks.alt: Ball-and-stick models jin mein har C, H aur O dikhaya gaya. Saturated fatty acid: seedhi zanjeer, har carbon par do H (aakhri par teen), aakhir mein C(=O)OH. Unsaturated fatty acid: C=C double bond (laal) zanjeer ko mor deta hai aur us ke dono carbons par ek ek H hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 4.32: Fatty acids (kitab ki Figure 4.32 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki Figure 4.32 mein labels ulte chhape hain: seedhi zanjeer jis ke har carbon par poore H hain, us par 'Unsaturated fatty acid' likha hai, aur mudi hui zanjeer par 'Saturated'. Sahih yeh hai: seedhi, poore H wali zanjeer saturated hai; jis zanjeer mein C=C double bond ho, H kam hon aur zanjeer mur jaye, woh unsaturated hai. Hamara khaaka sahih labels dikhata hai.
Fatty acids ki organic solvents mein hal hone ki salahiyat aur un ka melting point zanjeer mein carbon atoms barhne ke saath barhta hai.

Acylglycerols energy jama karne wale behtareen molecules hain, kyun ke in mein C-H bonds zyada hote hain. Non-polar hone ki wajah se yeh pani mein hal nahin hote, is liye jism mein khaas jagahon par jama kiye ja sakte hain. Janwaron ke fats mein podon ke oils se zyada energy hoti hai, kyun ke un mein saturated fatty acids aur is liye zyada C-H bonds hote hain; podon ke oils mein unsaturated fatty acids aur nisbatan kam C-H bonds hote hain. Jab jandaron ko glucose lambe arse ke liye jama karna ho to woh aam taur par usay fats ya oils mein badal dete hain.

blocks.alt: Teen fatty acids R-C(=O)-OH (OH roshan) aur glycerol, jis ke teen HO groups ka H roshan hai. Teer, 3H2O nikalte hain, aur triacylglycerol banta hai: har R-C(=O) ek O ke zariye glycerol se jura. Labels: R: Long hydrocarbon chain, 3 Fatty acids, Glycerol, 3H2O, Ester bond, Triacylglycerol.
blocks.caption: Figure 4.33: Triacylglycerol ki dehydration synthesis (kitab ki Figure 4.33 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Har fatty acid ka OH aur glycerol ke har OH ka H mil kar pani banate hain; teen fatty acids se teen pani (3H₂O) nikalte hain. Bacha hua O fatty acid ke C ko glycerol se jorta hai: yeh ester bond hai. Yaani OH acid (fatty acid) se aur H alcohol (glycerol) se nikalta hai, jaisa khaake mein dikhaya gaya hai.
Waxes

Kitab ke mutabiq waxes acylglycerols se bante (derived) hain. In mein carbon atoms bohat zyada hone ki wajah se in ka melting point zyada hai, is liye yeh room temperature par solid hote hain. Chemically waxes ki koi tay shuda structure aur composition nahin; yeh lambi zanjeer wale alkanes (jin mein carbon taaq (odd) tadaad mein, 25 se 35 tak), alcohols (glycerol ke ilawa), ketones aur lambi zanjeer wale fatty acids ka mixture hain.
Shehad ki makkhiyan wax banati hain aur is se apne chhatte ke chhe kone wale (hexagonal) khane banati hain jin mein shehad jama hota hai. Insanon mein bahari kaan ki nali ke glands wax banate hain.

Waxes chemically inert hain (aasani se react nahin karte). Doosre lipids ki tarah waxes bhi bohat hydrophobic (pani se door rehne wale) hain, is liye yeh jandaron ke liye hifazati ghilaf aur pani ki rukawat (water barrier) ka kaam karte hain. Phalon aur patton par wax ki hifazati teh aam hai. Kuch janwar, jaise keere, parinde aur bher waghaira, bhi apni jild par wax nikalte hain.

Waxes kaghaz aur cards ko waterproof banane mein istemal hote hain. Furniture, jooton aur gariyon ki wax polish mein bhi, aur mom-battiyan (candles) banane mein bhi. Rangdar pigments mila kar waxes se crayons aur rangdar pencils banaye jate hain (Figure 4.34: patton par wax, mom-battiyan, crayons, polish).
Phospholipids

Phospholipids plasma membranes banane mein aham structural kirdar ada karte hain. Chemically yeh phosphatidic acid se bante (derivatives) hain. Phosphatidic acid ek glycerol, do fatty acids aur ek phosphoric acid (phosphate) se bana hota hai. Jab koi nitrogenous base, jaise choline, ethanolamine ya serine, is ke phosphoric acid se jur jata hai to phospholipid ban jata hai. Aam misalein: phosphatidyl choline (lecithin), phosphatidyl ethanolamine aur phosphatidyl serine. Phosphatidyl choline (Figure 4.35) plasma membranes mein lipid bilayer (dohri teh) banata hai.

blocks.alt: Upar: chaar ajza formulas ke saath: Glycerol, Fatty acid, Phosphate, Nitrogenous base (Choline). Beech: phospholipid, ek hydrophilic sar (head) aur do hydrophobic dumein (tails). Neeche: poora molecule: choline - phosphate - glycerol, jis par do fatty acids; brackets Phosphatidic acid aur Phosphatidyl choline.
blocks.caption: Figure 4.35: Phosphatidyl choline, ek phospholipid (kitab ki Figure 4.35 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Phospholipid molecule ke do hisse hain: head (sar) aur tail (dum). Head polar hai (pani ko pasand karta hai) aur is mein nitrogenous base aur phosphate group hota hai; tail non-polar hai (pani se door rehti hai) aur is mein do fatty acids hote hain.
Terpenes

Terpenes lipids ka bohat bara aur mukhtalif group hain. Saare terpenes isoprene units se bane hain. Isoprene unit ek shaakhdar unsaturated hydrocarbon zanjeer hai jis ka formula CH₂=C(CH₃)−CH=CH₂ hai. Terpenes bohat se biological taur par aham pigments (rang dene wale maadde) banate hain, jaise podon mein chlorophyll aur aankhon mein retinal pigments. Vitamin A aur rubber bhi terpenes hain.

blocks.alt: Baayen: isoprene unit CH2=C(CH3)-CH=CH2. Daayen: isoprene ikaiyon se bani terpene zanjeer, CH2=C(CH3)-CH2-CH2-CH2-CH(CH3)-CH2-CH2-OH.
blocks.caption: Figure 4.36: Terpenes ki banawat (kitab ki Figure 4.36 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Steroids

Steroids woh lipids hain jin ka carbon dhancha mur kar chaar jure hue (fused) rings banata hai. Har steroid mein rings ka namoona ek jaisa hai: teen chhe kone wali rings aur ek paanch kone wali ring. Cholesterol janwaron ki cell membranes mein aam steroid hai. Janwaron ke cells isi se doosre steroids bhi banate hain, maslan mard aur aurat ke sex hormones.

blocks.alt: Chaar rings jo kinare share kar ke juri hain: teen chhe kone wali aur ek paanch kone wali; pehli ring par HO, doosri ring mein C=C double bond, do ring jorhon par CH3 groups, aur paanch kone wali ring par shaakh-daar hydrocarbon zanjeer CH(CH3)-CH2-CH2-CH2-CH(CH3)-CH3.
blocks.caption: Figure 4.37: Cholesterol: ek steroid (kitab ki Figure 4.37 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Chaar rings ek doosre se kinare (edge) share kar ke juri hain, kone (corner) se nahin.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki Figure 4.37 mein cholesterol ka HO group aur doosri ring ka C=C double bond nahin dikhaye gaye (aur caption mein 'Chdesterol' chhapa hai). Asal cholesterol mein pehli ring par OH group hota hai, isi liye yeh alcohol bhi hai, aur ek double bond hota hai; hamara khaaka yeh dono dikhata hai.

Lab mein banaye gaye anabolic steroids mard ke sex hormone (testosterone) jaise hain aur balaghat (puberty) mein mardon mein muscles aur haddiyon ka wazan barhane jaisa asar karte hain. 1950s mein kuch dawa banane wali companies ne anaemia ke ilaj ke liye anabolic steroids banaye. Kuch athletes ne jaldi muscles banane aur apni karkardagi (performance) barhane ke liye inhein istemal karna shuru kar diya. Aaj anabolic steroids par pabandi (ban) hai, kyun ke yeh sangeen jismani aur zehni masail, jaise gehri depression aur liver ka nuqsan, paida kar sakte hain.
Prostaglandins

Prostaglandins lipids ka ek group hain jo badle hue (modified) fatty acids hain; in ki non-polar tails ek paanch carbon wali ring se juri hoti hain. Yeh vertebrates (reerh ki haddi wale janwaron) ke bohat se tissues mein milte hain, jahan yeh local chemical messengers (qareebi cells ko paigham dene wale) ka kaam karte hain. Kuch smooth muscles ko sukarne aur dheela hone par uksate hain; kuch khoon ki naliyon ka qutr (diameter) tang ya chaura karte hain. Infection ke khilaf inflammation (sozish, soojan) mein bhi inka hissa hai.

blocks.alt: Paanch carbon ki ring jis par do OH groups hain, aur do zanjeerein: upar CH2 groups ki zanjeer jo C(=O)O- par khatm hoti hai, aur neeche CH=CH-CH(OH)-CH2-CH2-CH2-CH2-CH3.
blocks.caption: Figure 4.38: Ek prostaglandin (kitab ki Figure 4.38 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Aspirin prostaglandins ko rokti hai (prostaglandin inhibitor hai); isi liye yeh soojan, dard aur bukhar kam karti hai.
Role of lipids in life (zindagi mein lipids ka kaam)

items: Lipids energy (ATP) ka aham zariya hain; asal mein saare nutrients mein sab se zyada energy lipids mein hai. Ek gram lipid 9.5 kilocalories energy deta hai, jabke itna hi protein 5.6 aur carbohydrate 4.1 kilocalories deta hai.
Lipids tamam cellular aur subcellular membranes (cell aur us ke andar ke hisson ki jhilliyon) ka zaroori hissa hain.
Yeh fat mein hal hone wale vitamins A, D, E aur K ke jazb (absorb) hone ke liye biological carriers ka kaam karte hain.
Lipids fatty acids ka zariya hain, jo mukhtalif metabolic kaamon ke liye zaroori hain.
Lipids jism ke aham organs ke liye mechanical cushion (gaddi) aur sahare ka kaam karte hain.
Jild ke neeche mojood lipids (fats) jism ko bohat zyada garmi ya sardi se bachate (insulate karte) hain.

Steroids bohat se aham biological kaam karte hain. Maslan cholesterol membranes ko qaim rakhne mein hissa leta hai, lipids ki transport mein madad karta hai, aur vitamin D, bile acids, steroid hormones (androgens, oestrogens), adrenal hormones aur corticosteroids banne ka precursor (shuruati maadda) hai.

blocks.prompt: Podon ke oils room temperature par liquid aur janwaron ke fats solid kyun hote hain, aur fi gram kaun zyada energy jama karta hai?
blocks.explanation: Podon ke oils mein unsaturated fatty acids hain jin ke C=C double bonds zanjeer ko mor dete hain; is liye zanjeerein qareeb qareeb nahin jur paatin aur kam temperature par pighal jati hain. Janwaron ke fats mein saturated fatty acids ki seedhi zanjeerein hain jo qareeb qareeb jur jati hain aur zyada temperature par pighalti hain. Saturated zanjeeron mein C-H bonds zyada hain, is liye kitab ke mutabiq janwaron ke fats mein zyada energy hoti hai.

blocks.text: Mukhtasar khulasa

items: Lipids non-polar hain: pani mein hal nahin, organic solvents mein hal. Qismein: acylglycerols, waxes, phospholipids, terpenes, steroids, prostaglandins.

Acylglycerols glycerol aur fatty acids ke esters (triglycerides) hain; ester bante waqt OH acid se aur H alcohol se nikalta hai. Saturated fatty acids seedhe aur zyada melting point wale (janwaron ke fats); unsaturated mure hue aur kam melting point wale (podon ke oils). C-H bonds zyada hone se yeh energy ka achha zakheera hain.

Waxes hydrophobic hifazati teh hain; phospholipids (polar head, do fatty acid tails) membranes banate hain; terpenes isoprene units se bante hain (chlorophyll, vitamin A, rubber); steroids mein chaar jure rings hain (cholesterol, sex hormones); prostaglandins local messengers hain (aspirin inhein rokti hai).
Lipids 9.5 kilocalories fi gram dete hain, membranes banate hain, vitamins A, D, E, K le jate hain, fatty acids dete hain, organs ko cushion aur jism ko insulation dete hain.
